name: Norman Manley
contribution: A Jamaican statesman who served as the first and only premier of Jamaica.
legacy: This person arranged Jamaica's withdrawal from the union, chaired the committee and led the team that negotiated Jamaica's independence from the UK. This person then opted to call a general election even though his five-year mandate was barely halfway through.

checks.lead: Norman Washington Manley  (4 July 1893 – 2 September 1969) was a Jamaican statesman who served as the first and only premier of Jamaica. A Rhodes Scholar, Manley became one of Jamaica's leading lawyers in the 1920s.  Manley was an advocate of universal suffrage, which was granted by the British colonial government to the colony in 1944.
